description: Find top wallets ranked by volume, inflow, outflow, net flow, tx count, or realized PnL. On base and hyperevm window=all always works; 24h/7d/30d/90d only while those windows were refreshed in the last 2 days, otherwise a 400.

include_hubs.description: Also rank round-trip hubs (flash-loan/MEV/router pass-through wallets: volume of $10B or more, net flow and realized PnL each within 0.1% of it), hidden by default

window.description: Time window (default 30d; base and hyperevm default to all, and serve the others only while those windows are under 2 days old)
